title: Lymphocyte Sub-populations and Auto Immune Diseases
brief_summary: To determine if artificial intelligence allow to detect lymphocyte subpopulations specific of diseases (such as primary Sjogren' syndrome and systemic lupus erythematosus) among patients with suspicion of autoimmune diseases.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* autoimmune or infectious disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* No
study_population: autoimmune diseases (lupus and Sjogren's) or chonic infection (Whipple's disease)
